$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 41 (live withdrawal scenario). Criterion 3 is the load-bearing one: it fails unless the run reports 5 of 5 with nothing skipped, so a file recording another partial run cannot pass. Criterion 5 enforces §51 mechanically rather than by reminder -- it fails the file if a real Linear identifier appears in it, which is the defect that was actually caught once before in ADR-016.
